svg.metadata: {"title": "Asset tag", "description": "A thing's name, its id (and a Data Matrix of it, or of a link), where it lives.", "fields": {"name": {"default": "Thing"}, "id": {"default": "it-0001"}, "where": {"default": ""}, "link": {"default": "", "help": "the code holds this if given, else the id"}, "code": {"default": "datamatrix", "help": "datamatrix or qrcode"}}, "computed": {"holds": "{{#link}}{{link}}{{/link}}{{^link}}{{id}}{{/link}}"}, "example": {"name": "Drill, cordless", "id": "it-0042", "where": "Workshop, shelf 2"}}
